name: Nakanobu
tagline: Shinagawa in 15 minutes and Shibuya in 21 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where Tokyu and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 15 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 22.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 22.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 18.1 m to 23.2 m, a difference of 5.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 22 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 昭和医科大学病院附属東病院, about 14 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 昭和医科大学病院, about 15 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyu Oimachi Line and Toei Asakusa Line. The lines are split between operators (Tokyu runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Toei Asakusa Line runs at 123% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 本所吾妻橋→浅草, which this station is not on. Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118%. Its busiest stretch is 九品仏→自由が丘, which this station is likewise not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nakanobu is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nakanobu. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nakanobu.

neighbours.lead: Ebara-Machi is ahead on quiet, but Nakanobu is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nakanobu. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Nakanobu. One-room rents run about ¥6,000 lower.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
